Sungmin · Listen & Shadow 12

What Will You Research — the plan and the years after
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE RESEARCH
👤 Interviewer
What exactly do you want to research?
정확히 뭘 연구하고 싶으세요?
exactly — 정확히
💬 Sungmin
I want to build a transition manual that supports students with special needs.
특수교육 학생들의 전환을 돕는 안내서를 만들고 싶어요.
transition — 전환 · manual — 안내서 (build about ~은 틀린 형태)
같은 패턴으로 — I want to build a guide that helps new teachers. · I want to build a tool that saves them time.
💬 Sungmin
What's missing right now is a simple manual.
지금 없는 건 쉬운 안내서예요.
missing — 없는, 빠진 · simple — 쉬운
같은 패턴으로 — What's missing right now is time. · What's missing is a clear example.
💬 Sungmin
It has to be both theory-driven and field-driven.
이론에서도 오고, 현장에서도 와야 해요.
theory-driven — 이론에 기반한 · field-driven — 현장에 기반한
같은 패턴으로 — The plan is both data-driven and experience-driven. · It's user-driven, not budget-driven.
💬 Sungmin
No one has looked at that manual yet.
아직 아무도 그 안내서를 만들지 않았어요.
no one has ~ yet — 아직 아무도 ~하지 않았다 (I haven't seen that no one has ~는 이중부정이라 뜻이 꼬임)
같은 패턴으로 — No one has tested it yet. · No one has asked that question yet.
💬 Sungmin
Especially so parents and teachers can talk about the life skills these students will need.
특히 부모님과 교사가 아이에게 필요한 생활 기술을 함께 얘기할 수 있게요.
especially — 특히 · life skills — 살아가는 데 필요한 기술
같은 패턴으로 — Especially so new staff can find it fast. · Especially for the ones who leave school soon.
PART 2 · AFTER THE DEGREE
👤 Interviewer
What happens after you finish?
학위를 마치면 어떻게 하실 건가요?
finish — 마치다
💬 Sungmin
Once I finish, I'd go back to school.
마치고 나면 학교로 돌아갈 거예요.
once ~ — ~하고 나면 · go back to ~ — ~로 돌아가다
같은 패턴으로 — Once I finish, I'd take a short break. · Once the term ends, I'd start writing.
💬 Sungmin
I'd like to keep the option open.
가능성은 열어두고 싶어요.
keep the option open — 선택지를 열어두다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd like to keep both options open. · Let's keep that door open for now.
💬 Sungmin
In ten years, I'm not sure whether I'll still be a teacher.
10년 뒤에도 교사일지는 저도 확실하지 않아요.
whether — ~인지 아닌지 · still — 여전히
같은 패턴으로 — I'm not sure whether I'll stay in Seoul. · In five years, I'm not sure where I'll be.
💬 Sungmin
Either way, I'd want to connect the classroom and the research.
어느 쪽이든 현장과 연구를 잇는 일을 하고 싶어요.
either way — 어느 쪽이든 · connect — 잇다
같은 패턴으로 — Either way, I'd keep teaching part-time. · Either way, I'd stay close to the field.
PART 3 · DON'T SAY IT TWICE
👤 Interviewer
Say that again — but without the same word.
같은 말, 다르게 해볼까요?
without — ~ 없이
💬 Sungmin
Research — look into it, dig into it, find out how it works.
연구한다 — 들여다보다, 파고들다, 어떻게 돌아가는지 알아내다.
look into ~ — 들여다보다 · dig into ~ — 파고들다
같은 패턴으로 — I looked into three studies. · She dug into the numbers.
💬 Sungmin
Study — work on it, read up on it, spend time with it.
공부한다 — 붙들고 있다, 읽어보다, 시간을 들이다.
read up on ~ — ~에 대해 찾아 읽다
같은 패턴으로 — I've been reading up on brain science. · He's working on his thesis.
💬 Sungmin
Develop — build it, put it together, shape it.
만든다 — 짓다, 엮다, 모양을 잡다.
put together — 엮어 만들다 · shape — 모양을 잡다
같은 패턴으로 — We put together a short guide. · She shaped the whole program.
💬 Sungmin
The problem — what's not working, the gap, where it breaks down.
문제 — 안 되고 있는 것, 빈 곳, 어디서 막히는지.
gap — 빈 곳 · break down — 무너지다, 막히다
같은 패턴으로 — That's where it breaks down. · The gap is between school and work.
💬 Sungmin
The result — what came out of it, what we saw.
결과 — 거기서 나온 것, 우리가 본 것.
come out of ~ — ~에서 나오다
같은 패턴으로 — Here's what came out of it. · What we saw was the opposite.
녹음 17/17
